name: Dosukebe Bitch na ○gakusei no Sex Zanmai Nanokakan Sensou ~Homeless kara Himitsu Kichi o Torimodose!~
original_name: ドスケベビッチな○学生のセックス三昧七日間戦争 ～ホームレスからひみつ基地をとり戻せ!～
source:
Summer vacation was ending in 7 days.
Four friends - Kenta, Gaku, Maki and Sasara - went out to their "secret hangout"
in a fenced-off area forbidden to trespassers. The boys left the girls to do their usual
antics, trying to set off bottle rockets out of view.

While the girls played alone, two homeless men invaded their space.
"Nice place to sleep," one muttered. "Mnahgh," said the other.
Maki immediately unleashed her fiery spirit: "Hey, get out of here!
This is our secret hangout!" Sasara was more timid:
"D... don't come in here..."

One of the homeless men leered. "Sex match," he said flatly.
(What was that suppose to mean?) Whoever won would had to
leave the area. Pinky promise.

translation:
暑假只剩7天。健太、学、真纪和笹良四名朋友来到一处禁止擅入的围栏地带，作为他们的“秘密据点”。男孩们离开女孩，躲到看不见的地方放烟花。

女孩们独处时，两名流浪汉闯入了她们的地盘。

“真是个适合睡觉的地方。”其中一人嘟囔道。另一人含糊地应了一声。真纪立刻爆发：“喂，给我出去！这里是我们的秘密据点！”笹良胆怯地说：“别、别进来……”

其中一名流浪汉色眯眯地盯着她们：“性爱对决。”

（这是什么意思？）胜者就必须离开这里。双方拉钩保证。
